newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK housing block fire death toll rises to eight.
newsitem.headline: HK housing block fire death toll rises to eight.

text.p: A fire that raged through a Hong Kong residential building on Tuesday has claimed an eighth victim, the government said on Wednesday.
A 44-year-old woman died from injuries sustained in the fire, which had already claimed seven lives, a government statement said.
On Tuesday residents squatted on window ledges and clung to drainpipes to escape the fire as it spread from a sixth-floor apartment in a 20-storey block in Kowloon's Mei Foo district.
The dead included two babies. The cause of the flare-up was not immediately known and investigations are under way.
Hong Kong has suffered some of its worst building fires in recent months, including two major disasters.
In November, a fire in a building in Kowloon's Nathan Road tourist shopping street killed 39 people and injured 81.
A fire in a karaoke bar in January killed 17 people in Kowloon's Tsim Sha Tsui entertainment district.
